description:
Senior Sales Executive (Data Solutions)

Location: Remote (US)

 

We are

Virtual care only works if the infrastructure behind it does. Wheel builds that infrastructure: the systems that let telehealth run at scale for the patients, clinicians, and companies that depend on it. We're not bolting AI onto old workflows; we're rebuilding how care gets delivered, with AI in the product and in how we build it.

We do this in a live, regulated healthcare environment where getting it right matters. This is the next architecture of virtual care, and we're building it now.

About the Role

Wheel is building a commercial data and insights line, and we are hiring a Senior Data Solutions Sales Executive to own the revenue side of it. You will sell Wheel's data products and analytics offerings to external customers and run complex, consultative sales cycles from first conversation to signed deal. You will work closely with Product, Data, Legal, and Compliance so that every deal is structured responsibly.

This is a senior individual contributor role with a meaningful quota. You will also have real influence on how we position, price, and package our data offerings.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle for data and analytics products: prospecting, discovery, solution design, proposal, negotiation, and close.

  • Build and manage a pipeline against an annual quota, with accurate forecasting and consistent CRM hygiene.

  • Sell consultatively to technical and non-technical buyers, including data science, analytics, research, business development, and executive stakeholders.

  • Translate customer use cases into data product requirements and work with Product and Data teams to shape offerings.

  • Navigate complex buying processes, including security review, procurement, and contracting. Coordinate with Legal and Compliance on data use terms and governance. All contracts and data use terms go through Legal review.

  • Develop strategic accounts through multi-threaded relationships, expansion plays, and renewals.

  • Contribute to go-to-market strategy by providing market, competitive, and pricing feedback and helping refine positioning, packaging, and sales collateral.

  • Represent Wheel externally at industry events, customer meetings, and partner conversations.

  • Mentor more junior sellers and share best practices as the team grows.

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 6+ years of B2B sales experience, including 3+ years selling data, analytics, SaaS, or other technical products with complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • A record of meeting or exceeding quota in a senior individual contributor role.

  • Experience closing six-figure or larger deals.

  • Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and executive communication skills.

  • Comfort discussing data concepts with technical buyers, such as data licensing models, data quality, schemas, delivery methods, and de-identification at a conceptual level.

  • Proficiency with a CRM (for example, Salesforce) and sales engagement tools.

  • Sound judgment on privacy, compliance, and ethical data use, and a willingness to work within guardrails.

Preferred

  • Experience selling in healthcare, healthtech, life sciences, or other regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare data privacy concepts.

  • Existing relationships with life sciences, payer, provider, or digital health buyers.

  • Experience building a new product line or early-stage market.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

How We'll Measure Success

  • Attainment against annual new and expansion revenue quota

  • Pipeline coverage and forecast accuracy

  • Sales cycle velocity and win rate

  • Customer retention and expansion

  • Cross-functional partnership and compliance adherence

Salary and Perks

Pay Range: $116,900-$158,200, plus variable commission compensation and equity

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

 

As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision

  • Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability

  • 401K match

  • Flexible PTO

  • Parental Leave

  • Stock options

  • Additional programs and perks

     

Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

Research shows that underrepresented groups typically apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria listed. At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don’t check every box for the role.
